title: The Gray Boy's Plan for a Colorful Adolescence
overview: Haibara Natsuki travels back in time and gets a second shot at a better high school experience.

title: Dreamlike Days
overview: Natsuki hangs out with his new friends on the weekend.

title: Perfect Behavior
overview: Natsuki begins working at a café, and he and his friends study for midterm exams.

title: If You Support Me
overview: Without Tatsuya, Natsuki's once colorful adolescence slowly begins to darken.

title: I'll Give You an Umbrella When You're in the Rain
overview: Natsuki, Miori, Reita, and Hikari go on a double date.

title: Wish
overview: Natsuki convinces Miori to accept his help and attends a festival with Uta.

title: Aiming for the Ultimate Summer
overview: Natsuki's friends plan an overnight trip, but Hikari may not be able to attend.

title: Your Dream and the Secret Relationship
overview: Natsuki supports Hikari as she prepares to confront her overbearing father.

title: The End of a Miraculous Summer
overview: Natsuki heads to the beach with his friends for the colorful summer experience he's always dreamed of.

title: Facade
overview: Serika asks Natsuki to form a band with her.

title: Monochrome
overview: Natsuki is forced to confront his own feelings when he's asked to write lyrics for his band.

title: To the Stars
overview: On the day of the school festival, Natsuki performs with his band and expresses everything he's been feeling.
